sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:14

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:14:1
items.html:
The dot of Keter was drawn and expanded from its place down below, etc.: Meaning that a single Sefira of Keter expanded by itself into an entire Partzuf, a Rosh and a Guf, called the Partzuf Atik of Atzilut, whose place begins from the Tabur of AK and expands as far as the end of Atzilut.
And the reason for this expansion is the ascent of the bottom Hey to Keter. For in Nekudim, where the bottom Hey rose to the Einayim, every degree was thereby divided into two, the GE belonging to the upper one and the AHP to the lower one, in the manner of the division of AVI and YESHSUT. And now that the bottom Hey has risen to Keter, and all the nine lower ones are found to have gone outside the degree of Keter, Keter is therefore divided and becomes a complete degree in its own right: from the forehead upward are the GAR in it and the Rosh in it, and from the forehead downward is the aspect of the Guf and the ZAT in it. And this is what is called Atik of Atzilut. In this same way each and every Sefira of the ten Sefirot of MA was divided into a complete Partzuf in its own right, a Rosh and a Guf, as written further along.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:14:2
items.html: And each clothed the other down to the aspect of ZON: For every Partzuf is born and issues from the Peh of the Rosh of the upper one, and it therefore clothes the ZAT of the upper one, which are from the Peh downward.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:14:3
items.html: A little above the end of the legs of AK, and there is the end of the whole of Atzilut: For the end of the legs of AK is in the very point of this world, in the secret of the verse, “And his feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives.” The end of Atzilut, however, is what was made in the second restriction of AK, in which the Bina and ZON of the ten Sefirot of NHY of the aspect of SAG of AK went outside the world of Atzilut and became BYA of separation. Thus the distance between the end of Atzilut and the end of the legs of AK is as the measure of the aforementioned Bina and ZON of the ten Sefirot of NHY. And this is what he says, that the end of Atzilut is a little above the end of the legs of AK.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:14:4
items.html: Their vessels grew larger by having expanded down below, and thereby they have the power to receive their lights: For the greatness of the vessels means the multiplication of the screens, since the screens diminish the lights so that they expand in measure and in weight, in such a way that the lights are able to endure in the vessels.
